purpose: Structure only for engineering evidence tracking; not a qualification decision.

vulnerability_classes.name: Insecure Direct Object Reference
vulnerability_classes.causal_predicate_required: A distinct unauthorized identity receives the protected owner resource semantic identity while the owner baseline is authorized and an independent negative control is denied or unrelated.

vulnerability_classes.name: Path Traversal
vulnerability_classes.causal_predicate_required: Not eligible in the current WebGoat scope without an explicitly approved safe canary and bounded semantic observation.

vulnerability_classes.name: Unauthorized Object Access
vulnerability_classes.causal_predicate_required: A requester/owner relation must be established with independent identities, resettable state, semantic authorization observations, and an independent denial control.

approved_case_schema.blocked_or_inconclusive_policy: Never promote, score, or convert to TP/FP/FN/clean.

evidence_maturity_levels.meaning: Source-backed hypothesis only; no target observations.
Safe preconditions and reset are verified, but no complete causal observation chain exists.
Baseline/candidate/control observations exist, but the oracle is not CONFIRMED or evidence is not target_runtime.
A target_runtime CONFIRMED causal result has a sealed ProofBundle and deterministic successful replay.
evidence_maturity_levels.qualification_note: Engineering promotion only; official qualification still requires separate governance and run gates.

current_entries.reason: Independent owner/attacker LessonSession fixture, resettable owner resource, and semantic target observation are unavailable within the approved scope.
